summary: Verified the new mobile-first dashboard (/app/index.html) end-to-end on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports plus regressions on /inventory, /rera-import, /client-workspace. All requested data-testids, hrefs, counts, and interactions work correctly. No console errors, no page errors, no layout breaks observed.

regressions./inventory: 200 OK, page loaded (title: Inventory — Signature Property)

observations: Note: mod-dups shows 0 while the review request expected 1. The API /api/v2/duplicates/pending currently returns an empty (or non-pending) list — this is a data-driven value, not a UI bug. Confirm if seeded data is expected to have 1 pending duplicate.
Note: mod-hot count is derived from Tag/ClientStatus 'hot' matches on leads (4 found) — no dedicated /hot-leads endpoint. Working as coded.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is 505 lines with inline CSS + JS. Acceptable for a landing dashboard but if it grows further, extract CSS/JS into /app/public/ for cacheability.
boot() swallows failures silently — if /api/leads fails, ALL_LEADS stays empty and stats show '—' without user-visible error. Consider a small error banner when leadsRes.ok !== true.
loadSiteVisits() calls /api/v2/site-visit-bookings?leadId=all which is a made-up endpoint; it will silently fall back to '0'. Confirm intent (aggregate query) or wire to a real endpoint.
renderStats() uses ALL_INV.filter(p => !p._deleted) but v2 inventory rows may not carry a _deleted flag; harmless but dead check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New dashboard is fully verified (desktop + mobile). All data-testids exist with correct hrefs. Smart-call modal opens/closes via all three methods. Mobile hamburger + FAB both wired correctly. Regressions on /inventory, /rera-import, /client-workspace pass. Duplicates count is 0 rather than 1 — verify seed data if a non-zero value is expected.
